title: Bound Until Death
description: Assassinate Vittoria Vici at her wedding in Solitude. Kill her during her speech for a bonus reward, then report back to Astrid at the Sanctuary.

base_facts: Leader of the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary. Assigns contracts to family members.

MISSION_BRIEFING: Has tasked the player with assassinating Vittoria Vici at her wedding in Solitude. Bonus reward if killed during her speech to the guests.
VITTORIA_KILLED: Knows Vittoria Vici is dead. Awaiting the player's return to the Sanctuary.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Rewarded the player with the Summon Spectral Assassin spell, and leveled gold if Vittoria was killed during her speech.
Believes Vittoria's murder has set the Brotherhood on a path toward the assassination of an Emperor, a path not traveled in centuries.
Knows the Emperor will now be forced to visit Skyrim to deal with the aftermath, paving the way for his assassination.
Directing the player to speak with Gabriella to proceed to the next stage of the plan, starting the quest Breaching Security.

base_facts: The Emperor's cousin. Marrying Asgeir Snow-Shod at the Temple of the Divines in Solitude.

MISSION_BRIEFING: The target for assassination. Will address the wedding guests from the balcony.

base_facts: A vampire child who is a member of the Dark Brotherhood.

MISSION_BRIEFING: Mentioned a loose gargoyle statue hanging above the balcony where Vittoria will give her speech. It could be pushed to fall on the target.

base_facts: A Dunmer assassin of the Dark Brotherhood.

MISSION_BRIEFING: Surveyed the wedding site and left Firiniel's End bow and arrows on a parapet opposite the balcony for a long-range kill.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Has been assisting Astrid with arranging the player's next contract regarding the Emperor's visit to Skyrim.
Ready to brief the player on the next stage of the plan, starting the quest Breaching Security.

beats.comment: Player receives the contract to assassinate Vittoria Vici at her wedding.
Vittoria Vici has been assassinated. Player must report back to Astrid.
Player reports to Astrid, receives reward, and quest completes.
